copy.html:
SuperEnalotto is an official Italian lottery launched in December 1997 by Sisal SpA. SuperEnalotto replaced the Enalotto game that had been played since the 1950's. The lottery is operated by the Italian government. What makes SuperEnalotto different as to other lotteries is that there is no cap on the rollover of the jackpot.

The draw takes place four times a week, usually on every Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday. This can sometimes change a little when one of the draw days falls on a significant public holiday, or if a special event draw is introduced. The results are updated on our website shortly after each draw. Do you dream of financial freedom? It's time to play the SuperEnaLotto lottery online!

How Much Could You Win?

There are a total of six prize payout tiers for the SuperEnaLotto lottery. Matching all the numbers will bag you that jackpot, but you still win money for matching only two numbers. In addition to this, you could win a €25 'Instant Win' spot prize for matching a 'magic square' of four random numbers which is printed on your ticket when it is purchased.

Playing SuperEnaLotto Lottery Online

Playing is very easy! A SuperEnaLotto ticket has a total of six main numbers (from 1 to 90) to choose. To enter, simply log in to LottosOnline, select the SuperEnaLotto lottery, and choose your numbers. Alternatively, you can use our Quick Pick random number selector - the choice is yours entirely.

Once we have received your entry and payment, our local ticket purchasing agents will buy your official lottery ticket. You will be sent confirmation via email and your entry will be stored securely until after the draw, when it will be verified against the results.

You've Won! What Happens Next?

Whether it's a life-changing sum or a little bit of extra cash you could use to treat yourself, it's always an incredible feeling to win! If the ticket you have bought via LottosOnline is a winning entry, you will be informed by email. We won't keep you in suspense! You can also check the latest SuperEnaLotto lottery results on our results page.

All winning numbers are carefully verified after the draw. If you win the jackpot we'll be in touch to discuss the arrangements to unite you with your lottery winning ticket. All other winnings will be credited to your LottosOnline Winnings Balance straight away. Just log in and decide how to use them! Either convert winnings to credit in your Account Balance to buy more tickets or request that our agents trigger a fund transfer to your bank account. It really is that simple!

Fun Facts About SuperEnaLotto Lottery

Did you know?

  • The largest shared SuperEnaLotto jackpot to date was €177-Million, back in October 2010. It was won by a group of 70 players.
  • The largest single SuperEnaLotto jackpot win was €209-Million, won by one very lucky single ticket holder in August 2019 after more than a year of rollovers.
